items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: I know him, too. ... You were right next to him for a long time, there, at the Union.

ctx.x: Let's just see if there's anybody else through that period that I can think about and would like to ask about. Okay, what do you remember about Lester Young, because --
Well, Lester Young came here -- he came here. I don't know, he got a band somewhere, (inaudible) who was with the band. Oh, Mr. Young's -- his father, we called him Mr. Young.
